authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES the preview-scoped DR-117 successor candidate authorized by D-132 / file 12 §5. It is not a second register row. It does not SATISFY DR-117. It does not treat product-boundary-successor-contract.v8 or product-boundary-preview.v2 as SATISFIED. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Disposition the seven file-02 product-boundary items as they apply to the D-002 architecture preview, with determinate preview enforcement classes owned by this candidate where no existing gate actually tests the property.

productBoundarySuccessorV8.role: Remains DR-117's leftover T2-02 candidate for general succession. This artifact does not replace, apply, or succeed v8.

productBoundaryPreviewV2.role: D-068 is the owner recording. preview.v2 is the effective disposition it records for DR-010 / condition 1. D-068 does not close DR-117. This artifact is not a restatement of preview.v2 as DR-117 SATISFIED.

lineage.relation: Preview-scoped complement authorized by D-132. Not silent succession from preview.v2. v8 stays leftover T2-02. File 12 has no authority.
lineage.previewReadAs: These seven dispositions plus this candidate's determinate enforcement classes are the proposed preview-scoped successor candidate. They do not effect SATISFIED.

p1p2g3Mapping.P-1: Preserved for the preview by items 1 and 2: no marketplace, public lifecycle parity, discovery service, or ecosystem governance depth.
p1p2g3Mapping.P-2: Preserved for the preview by items 3 and 5: narrow/data-only contribution; no contributor-owned policy, persistence, rendering, termination, host lifecycle, probes, project hooks, or root commands. Host-owned consented doctor probes remain host acts (D-002 / D-032).
p1p2g3Mapping.G3: Partially replaced for the preview by item 7: TypeScript-only analysis role; rustc_driver sidecar remains the substrate and is deferred as a supported analysis role, not abandoned.

registerRowQuoted.rowLocationDiscipline: Locate the row by the line beginning '| DR-117 |'.
registerRowQuoted.acceptanceEvidenceCellVerbatim: Explicit successor to P-1/P-2/G3 with enforcement evidence

cellLimbs.standing: Answered as specified-classes-not-executed for admission/request exclusions and for honesty/disclosure of unprevented trusted-TCB ambient effects. This candidate does not claim host confinement of a running first-party component. Prevention of ambient egress is DR-128 post-MVP, not this preview. Not QUALIFIED. Not SATISFIED.

sevenItems.countPin: D-011, seven items. Any change to that enumeration re-opens DR-117.

dispositions.name: marketplace/catalog and governance depth
dispositions.preview: NO. First-party / explicitly trusted components only. No marketplace.

dispositions.name: external lifecycle parity and discovery
dispositions.preview: NO public lifecycle parity. Host-owned one lifecycle for first-party components.

dispositions.name: contribution roles beyond narrow/data-only
dispositions.preview: NO. P-2 narrow producers / data-only remains. Findings stay host-owned (DR-133 / D-136 candidate). Persistence, rendering, termination, and host lifecycle remain host-owned; they are not DR-133's output-law surface.

dispositions.name: untrusted native or WASM admission and required enforcement evidence
dispositions.preview: NO admission. DR-128 stays post-MVP. DR-G21 is not a sandbox. Demonstrated OS/WASM enforcement, matrix, escape tests, revocation, incident ownership attach to DR-128, not condition 4. Preview enforcement is EE-4.

dispositions.name: imperative contributions, probes, project hooks, and root commands
dispositions.preview: NO as contribution roles. Imperative contributions as a class, contribution-owned probes, project hooks, and contributor-owned root commands remain excluded. Host-owned consented doctor probes remain host acts under D-002 / D-032. No contributor owns a root command. Analyze stays offline.

dispositions.name: network-granted analysis and egress defaults
dispositions.preview: NO. Offline preview. No network-granted analysis default.

dispositions.name: replacement of the full-default G3 physical substrate
dispositions.preview: PARTIAL, recorded: TypeScript is the only preview language role. Default useful install is signed distribution core + semantic host + one selected TypeScript closure + the future DR-131 pack (pack not invented here). Core-only is recovery/management, not the analysis product. rustc_driver sidecar remains the substrate and is deferred as a supported analysis role, not abandoned. D-002 independent-release surface is preserved, not narrowed.

enforcementEvidence.ownerOfUnownedPreviewClasses: This candidate (DR-117 preview successor). Classes below with owner=this-candidate are specified here. They are not assigned to a live DR-G whose row does not test the property.
enforcementEvidence.cellAnswer: Preview enforcement evidence is (1) excluded-form admission refusal and (2) honest DISCLOSURE-ONLY treatment of trusted-TCB ambient effects already recorded at DR-105 / D-128. Demonstrated OS/WASM confinement remains DR-128. DR-G01..G05 do not own analyze egress. This candidate does not invert D-128 FX-2B.

v1SlicePin.verbatim: A `PlanIntent` containing an excluded form is rejected during request validation with the required typed outcome and creates no `ExecutionId`, `AttemptRecord`, `ExecutionPlan`, or authoritative Run; a substitution after admission is also rejected before any stage executes.

classes.invariant: No marketplace, public catalog, or ecosystem governance. First-party / explicitly trusted only.
classes.input: An otherwise well-formed admission request whose component publisher is not first-party and not on the explicit-trust list.
classes.pass: Refused at admission. No ExecutionId. v1-slice §7 item 8.
classes.existingGate: none. DR-104 is identity/namespace, not marketplace admission.
classes.laterExecution: Specified here. Unexecuted. Not QUALIFIED. Not assigned to condition 4 by default.

classes.invariant: No public lifecycle parity or external discovery service.
classes.input: A PlanIntent or admission request that requires an external discovery or public-lifecycle endpoint.
classes.pass: Excluded form. Refused in request validation. No ExecutionId.

classes.input: A TypeScript provider payload offering a finding or findingLikeResult.

classes.invariant: Contributors do not own policy, persistence, rendering, termination, or host lifecycle.
classes.input: A manifest claiming policy, persistence, rendering, termination, or host-lifecycle authority.

classes.invariant: Untrusted native or WASM is not admitted. DR-G21 is not a sandbox.
classes.input: A PlanIntent or manifest requesting untrusted native or WASM admission.
classes.pass: Excluded form. Rejected in request validation; no ExecutionId / AttemptRecord / ExecutionPlan / authoritative Run. Post-admission substitution rejected before any stage.
classes.owner: this-candidate for preview refusal. DR-128 for demonstrated OS/WASM enforcement (post-MVP, not condition 4).
classes.existingGate: DR-G21 does not own this property.
classes.laterExecution: Preview class specified here, unexecuted. DR-128 leftover-design remains on DR-128.

classes.invariant: Contribution-owned project hooks, root commands, and probes are excluded.
classes.input: A component manifest claiming a project hook, root command, or contribution-granted probe.
classes.existingGate: none for the contribution-role refusal. Host-owned doctor probes remain D-002 / D-032 / DR-114.

classes.invariant: Generic imperative contribution, if represented as a request or protocol substitution, is excluded before stage execution. Arbitrary ambient acts of an already-running trusted-TCB component are not admission-enforced and are not claimed confined.
classes.input: A PlanIntent, manifest, or protocol frame that substitutes an imperative contribution (not merely a named hook/root/probe) after admission but before any stage executes.
classes.pass: Detected substitution is rejected before any stage executes (v1-slice §7 item 8). If the act is only an ambient trusted-TCB effect with no request/protocol representation, this class does not apply; that effect is trusted-code behavior, not an admission exclusion.
classes.owner: this-candidate for the constructible pre-stage substitution. Ambient trusted-TCB acts have no preview confinement owner.

classes.input: A PlanIntent whose analysis branch requests network-granted analysis.
classes.pass: Excluded form. Refused in request validation. No ExecutionId.
classes.existingGate: none. DR-G01..G05 measure download bytes, installed closure, help/version, memory, and component cost. They do not own this property.

classes.invariant: Component-originated PT-NET-EGRESS under ambient authority is DISCLOSURE-ONLY in the preview. The host neither observes nor prevents the ACT. A refused ASK is not a blocked ACT. This is honesty, not confinement.
classes.input: A first-party analyzer performs direct denied PT-NET-EGRESS under ambient authority (D-128 FX-2B shape).
classes.pass: The connection may succeed. The host journal need not record it. The class PASSES only if the product does not claim host prevention. Claiming fail-closed host prevention FAILS this class. A later rejected Run is result integrity, not evidence that egress did not occur.
classes.owner: DR-105 / D-128 / permission-truth-tables.v9 05d559647d103a47c18ed5177b71900a1d9dfcdea6b9a1255aefcec5f09eaccb. D-032 places component CA-4 egress at DR-105.
classes.existingGate: DR-G09 leftover of DR-105; not DR-G01..G05. Demonstrated prevention remains DR-128. DR-G09 harness identifiers remain unauthored (D-086); that is not doubt about which gate owns the honesty property.
classes.laterExecution: Honesty tables already specified at D-128. Unexecuted here. Not QUALIFIED.

classes.subLimb: useful-install inventory and core-only is not the analysis product
classes.invariant: Default useful install is signed distribution core + semantic host + one selected TypeScript closure + future DR-131 pack. Core-only is recovery/management.
classes.input: A release that advertises core-only as the analysis product, or that omits the selected TypeScript closure from the default useful install.
classes.owner: this-candidate for the aggregate default-useful-install *selection* (core + host + one TS closure + future DR-131 pack) and the core-only-is-not-analysis-product rule. DR-101 / D-114 distribution-core-inventory owns only the signed-distribution-core inventory and excludes analyzer components from that core closure.
classes.existingGate: DR-101 does not own the TypeScript-closure limb of the useful install. Pack identity remains DR-131.
classes.laterExecution: Selection class specified here, unexecuted. Core inventory leftover remains on DR-101.

classes.invariant: Preview admits one language role: TypeScript. A second preview language role is refused.
classes.input: A preview PlanIntent or release that admits a second language role.
classes.owner: D-002 / DR-118 product role-list decision (TypeScript sole preview role).
classes.existingGate: DR-G13 is the future per-supported-role language-quality corpus, not the second-role refusal. The discriminating evidence is the role-list decision, not G13 green.
classes.laterExecution: Role-list specified here / D-002. G13 leftover measurement remains condition 4 for quality, not role-count.

classes.invariant: The selected TypeScript closure is self-contained / offline-capable.
classes.input: A TypeScript closure that requires ambient/implicit download.
classes.existingGate: DR-G14 only. Does not own role-set, lockstep, or useful-install inventory.
classes.laterExecution: DR-G14 leftover measurement remains condition 4. Not QUALIFIED.

classes.invariant: The sidecar remains the substrate and a deferred supported analysis role.
classes.input: A preview product statement that abandons or deletes the rustc_driver sidecar as a future supported role.

classes.invariant: The selected TypeScript closure is independently releasable and not lockstepped to the core version train.
classes.input: A release system that emits the selected TypeScript closure only on the same version train as the core.
classes.pass: Fails IR-1..IR-4 / G16-12 of the recorded monorepo-ci-contract.v16 (D-124).
classes.laterExecution: Unexecuted leftover on DR-121. Not QUALIFIED.
